uncovered_constraints_packaged: R02 validates the same-run R01 handoff, its output hashes, and a cumulative runtime ledger containing exactly the R01 prefix before runtime work, then preserves those hashes without editing predecessor state.

The full batch8_concurrent_requests contract is explicit: eight ordered 16-32K requests, concurrency eight, infinite request rate, 1024 output tokens each, two excluded warmups, temperature zero, and ignored EOS.
Every R02 execution and artifact preserves physical DCUs 0 and 1, DP ranks 0 and 1, rank 0 to device 0, rank 1 to device 1, world size two, TP1, PP1, DP2 mp, and the no-single-device-promotion gate.
Formal runtime validation has Python standard-library implementations; missing jq or rg is not a failure and never authorizes a model rerun.
The model-forward wrapper inspects the current signature and validates input_ids, inputs_embeds, or an explicitly proven positional slot against the SAME_INPUT phase/q_len/kv_len grid.

Linear-attention and full-attention receive separate shallow and deep FX evidence; output-buffer slice assignment and dynamic view shape expansion require source-preserving Proxy semantics or audited leaf boundaries, never fabricated graphs.

The Workflow 02 Process Range Inventory retains every required leading field, uses fragment rows with shared aggregation keys for cross-function processes, and exposes unresolved or ambiguous mappings.
HIPTX/ROCTX is native while NVTX names remain only compatibility vocabulary; the adapter is guarded, balanced, non-synchronizing, and records small joinable metadata.
The current R02 sidecar defines an ordered exact adapter-name multiset and multiplicities; broad prefixes and context markers such as qwen_dcu.generate_total cannot enter the measurement set.
Wrappers are installed once per module identity and semantic role while every alias path and declared layer index is retained; expected counts follow layer occurrences, not unique bindings.
Every failed FX or equivalence attempt is isolated under attempts/fx_trace_failed_NNN with its logs, partial outputs, error, source hashes, and cleanup status; fixes remain artifact-local.

Output equivalence, guard-off zero events, exact guard-on counts, marker nesting, full rank/device coverage, wrapper cleanup, unchanged source AST/files, and a clean target worktree all gate the business handoff.
The compatibility-named Workflow 02 business handoff has all exact required headings, carries current FX/source/sidecar/equivalence hashes, and prominently identifies HIPTX/ROCTX as operational.

The downstream interface records the fixed hipprof environment setup, libLLVM launch-error interpretation, case-insensitive pftrace capability check, exact-name selection, and raw DB/PFTrace/auxiliary allowlist without performing any profiler work in R02.
A post-capture raw-inventory defect belongs to R03 offline repair with byte preservation and cannot cause R02 to run or rerun capture.
R02 produces no process timing, launch-owned kernel attribution, GPU launch order, or performance report; those remain gated R03 responsibilities.
Business artifacts stay below runtime_artifact_root; one scheduler handoff is written only to runtime_handoff_output after all checks pass; R03 cannot start before validation.
